relationships.evidence_quote: This leads to the release of neuropeptides, including substance P, neurokinin A (NKA), and calcitonin gene-related peptide (CGRP) [74].

key_findings: CB1R and CB2R mRNA were detected in the horse lateral amygdala, while TRPV1 and PPARγ mRNA were undetectable in fixed samples.
CB1R, CB2R, TRPV1 and PPARγ immunoreactivity were all present in the equine lateral amygdala nucleus.
